method: Same original Alpine Firefox 142.0-r0, existing isolated profile/store, offline JS/Canvas page, four CPUs, 4096 MiB logical guest budget, network off. No Firefox patch or settings workaround.

input.metric: Native mouse release delivered to Trames through observed JavaScript title acknowledgement; excludes drawable presentation and automation round-trip time.

cpu.method: 1 ms Time Profiler running-thread samples, disjoint categories across all process threads. Exploratory 15 s windows; progress/cache state is not matched. These percentages are not UI latency or a throughput speedup. vCPU includes HVF entry/exit.

limitations: Small sequential warm-profile sample; no cold-cache randomization or native Firefox reference. No tail-percentile or near-native performance claim.
The final extra commit only retires software snapshots on entering hardware mode; its affected checks passed separately, while unchanged full-CI results are reused.
Scoped guest Rust references and atomic callbacks still require exclusion. Writable provider/code pages still need conservative publication.
The remaining sampled cost includes View preparation, filesystem checkpoints and VFS/resource preparation.
Per-worker translation cache is bounded; expired history, cache eviction and full snapshots can still require reconciliation. Fork eager detachment remains.
A final metrics-only filter excludes dead weak aliases from mapped-byte reporting; disabled-metrics Firefox execution is unchanged.
